Both callbacks are recorded on the hub with reviewer `session-3e91d45e…` (this Claude session) ≠ assignee `session-6cb6cfd1…` (codex Root), so the different-provider requirement is genuinely satisfied.

## Verdicts

**Preparation `task-b1b346…` — ACCEPT** (compliance PASS / quality PASS)
**Execution `task-25944ceb…` — REWORK** (compliance PASS on artifacts / quality REWORK on one defect)

## Hashes I recomputed myself — all six matched exactly

| Artifact | Result |
|---|---|
| execution-packet.json | `39e88dda…c97e73` ✓ |
| publish-preview.sh | `9a013416…b1f9454` ✓ |
| render_publication.py | `0260ea91…239cf6` ✓ |
| publish_release.py | `fe8844c6…f7afc5` ✓ |
| local archive | `6ddd1231…6c79ab` ✓, **332** file members ✓ |

Plus all 12 preparation-evidence files, `prepare-resume-contract.json` `60cf6920`, and the staged tree: api `f4d69555` and nginx `e9add812` unchanged, JS `71930a6a`, articles `b05cffdd` (279 entries), version.json exactly 136/4084/279 at both commit fields `06dfa0bc…`. HEAD equals the frozen commit and the content-path diff is empty.

## What I verified rather than accepted

- **The exit-1 stop is honest.** I counted the preflight heredoc myself: line 17 is exactly the `f_bavail` 20 % assert, nothing else. Disk math confirms it: 20,470,980,608 of 102,417,174,528 = **19.988 %**, correctly below gate. The preflight body is byte-identical across initial wrapper, cutover.sh, resume-prepare.sh and publish-preview.sh — no gate was lowered, no log overwritten. The initial log ends with the real build (`manifest list sha256:95ad1112…`) and the complete runtime receipt *before* the stop.
- **The resume really is the original suffix.** Byte comparison, not trust: identical preamble, and the tail from `quiz_archive=` is byte-identical to cutover's, hashing to the recorded `9387589c…` — with zero `helm upgrade`, `docker build` or `rehearse-`. Its added middle is strictly *stronger* (pins cutover/archive hashes, re-runs `verify_runtime_receipt`, asserts live image ID `95ad1112`, backup 0600 + exact hash + integrity, re-queries the rehearsal SQLite for `(15, 335)`).
- **Cleanup was lossless.** The deleted 638 backup is proven byte-identical to the retained 0600 one (same 49,364,992 bytes, same SHA). `release-imported-duplicate.sh` proves zero dependent containers and the presence of both k3s images plus the exact durable archive *before* removing only the Docker alias.
- **Root cause of the prior A11Y failure is genuinely fixed** in the shipped asset: one `038a7a47` Greek002 reference, zero `e441297`.
- **Provenance is real.** Both independent review files carry genuine hub callbacks with real distinct session IDs, ACCEPTED, cli exit 0 — not invented metadata.

## The one flaw (why REWORK)

`helm upgrade --atomic --wait --timeout 180s`: with `--atomic`, a wait timeout triggers an automatic rollback that **also** waits up to 180 s. Remote worst case ≈ 180 + 180 s plus ~40 s of preamble ≈ 400 s, but `publish_release.py:13` caps the ssh at `timeout=300`.

Then `TimeoutExpired` fires at line 13, so line 14 never runs: `publish-log.txt` and `publish-exit.json` are never written — no evidence of what production did — while the channel closes mid-rollback and the release can be left pending-rollback, needing manual recovery. That is precisely the path where evidence and a clean rollback matter most. This repo's own earlier executors (ACTING_CRAFT, FILM_CRAFT, HOME_ALONE, MUSIC_CRAFT, SCREEN_SONG) all used `timeout=600`.

**Smallest correction:** line 13 `timeout=300` → `600`, and write the log/exit in a `try/finally`. Nothing else moves — preview script, image, archive, values and the rendered pin `64357e6b` are untouched; only the executor hash changes, which its own line-7 self-hash assert correctly converts into a required fresh acceptance. Leave preview lines 41-42 (duplicate nginx check) alone — editing them would break the byte-identity property.

**Exact guarded execution is not approved until that two-line fix plus a fresh acceptance binding the new executor hash.** Everything else about the packet is approval-grade: single atomic upgrade, baseline 58/image `4878f824`/PVC `7fc2428f` asserted, exclusive `flock`, pinned hashes, fresh 0600 backup with an independent restore-proof and row reconciliation, full preflight immediately before upgrade, deterministic rollback, PVC untouched, 29 feedback still OPEN. No approval file exists and I created none; I ran no executor.
